md5.derivation: length IS NOT A STORED FIELD: pathobj.PathObject.length is the PROPERTY step_range[1] - step_range[0] + 1. pathobj.plant_from_pair builds step_delta as tuple(P.sub32(trp.q[i], tr.q[i]) for i in range(a, b+1)), i.e. EXACTLY ONE modular difference per step of the closed range, so len(step_delta) == length on every object it builds. Every constructor that reaches this population preserves that: equivalence.act_E1_shift carries step_delta over and shifts BOTH ends of step_range; act_E3_negate negates element-wise at constant range; controlpower.perturb_message_difference and perturb_by_codeword copy __dict__ and touch neither. THEREFORE the serialised step_delta VALUE determines length as its own tuple length: length = len(step_delta). This is a derivation from committed source and not a property of the census.

sha1.derivation: ON SHA-1 the serialised message_difference is tuple(obj.dv), and pathobj.plant_from_pair sets obj.dv = full_dv[a:b+1] over the closed step range, so len(dv) == length. equivalence.act_E1_shift sets dv = full[a+s : b+s+1] and step_range = (a+s, b+s), preserving both sides; act_E3_negate leaves dv untouched; controlpower.perturb_message_difference XORs bits in place and perturb_by_codeword XORs an 80-word codeword element-wise, neither changing the word count. THEREFORE the serialised message_difference VALUE determines length as its own tuple length on SHA-1. IT DOES NOT HOLD ON MD5, where delta_m is ALWAYS 16 words whatever the length.

evidence/obstruction.supersedes: EV-DIFFP-b878aa's obstruction block, BY REFERENCE AND WITHOUT EDITING IT. That block is immutable, its value of 2 of 5 ablations detected is CORRECT AS MEASURED, and nothing here says otherwise. evidence/obstruction.statement: IN AN EXACT-KEY ADJUDICATOR WHOSE MEMBERSHIP KEY CONTAINS FUNCTIONALLY DEPENDENT COMPONENTS, A SINGLE-COMPONENT ABLATION BATTERY MEASURES, IN ORDER, THE PERTURBING FAMILIES' CONSTRUCTION, THE KEY'S FUNCTIONAL-DEPENDENCY GRAPH, AND ONLY THEN THE INSTRUMENT. This is a property of the OBJECT and not of the attempt. Membership is exact equality on a serialised tuple, so deleting a component makes the acceptance region unbounded in it; a family that perturbs exactly the set S while holding every other key component fixed therefore makes the row deleting S accept by construction, and a component that is a function of a retained component cannot be detected at all. The rows that remain are the only ones a better or worse instrument could move.

THE PRIMARY READING, WHICH IS A THEORY THAT TAKES THIS MEASUREMENT AS ITS HYPOTHESIS: A PER-COMPONENT ABLATION PROFILE IS NOT A REPORT CARD ON A SUITE, IT IS A MAP OF THE MEMBERSHIP KEY'S FUNCTIONAL-DEPENDENCY STRUCTURE, AND THAT MAP IS A STATICALLY COMPUTABLE OBJECT. Two things follow that are not currently in this program's framing. (1) The dependency graph PARTITIONS every NOT DETECTED verdict into three kinds a single column conflates -- provably undetectable, not probed, and probed-and-genuinely-not-detected -- which is the honest replacement for any fraction and, measured here, gives 1, 3 and 0 respectively. (2) It COLLAPSES THE DEPTH-2 COMBINATORIAL COST: you do not need all fifteen depth-2 subsets, you need the subsets that BREAK A DEPENDENCY, which here is exactly one and is already row 5. An obstruction that reads "the depth-2 lattice is unmeasured and unaffordable" becomes a two-row question. The audit costs one read-only script and no charged run. THE SECOND READING, WHICH IS A DESIGN CONSTRAINT RATHER THAN AN EXPERIMENT: the rule of O-12 says a power measurement must perturb a set that is NOT the deleted set. That is precisely the OFF-DIAGONAL of a family-by-row matrix, and it makes the difference between a matrix that is a function of the families' construction and one that carries information about the instrument into a COUNT OF DIFFERING CELLS -- an integer-valued, two-outcome discriminator, run once against the honest instrument and once against a known-false one. THE THIRD READING, CROSS-GOAL AND OFFERED RATHER THAN ASSERTED: GOAL-SHA1-001 asks what a deployed collision DETECTOR covers over the disturbance-vector class. "Which component of a predicate carries its verdicts, and which components are functions of others" is structurally the same question, and this round's finding that a SHA-1 key's apparent 2560 bits are at most 512 plus one on in-code objects is exactly the kind of statement a detector-coverage audit needs. OFFERED WITH ITS SCOPE ATTACHED. This goal states no detector-coverage conclusion.
